items.title: Skydance (SKYD) Closes Its Merger, Is The Discount A Warning Sign?
items.summary: Skydance (SKYD) has just completed a transformative step. The company closed its merger with Warner Bros. Discovery, supported it with large new debt financings, and is reshaping leadership around television and streaming operations. items.title: What Is Skydance (SKYD) Signaling With Its New Board And Leadership Team?
items.summary: Skydance (NYSE: SKYD) reshaped its board after closing the Warner Bros. Discovery merger, adding several high-profile figures. items.title: Skydance Rebounds 5% as Warrant Adjustment Selloff Fades; Netflix Rises 3%, Disney Advances 2%
items.summary: A warrant adjustment sent Skydance shares into freefall, but buyers are already stepping back in while Netflix and Disney post quieter gains. What the split between the common stock and the newly trading warrants reveals about where value actually sits may surprise investors.
